resources.string: Requires Android 14+ and LSPosed API 102. Enable this app for the system server (system) scope in LSPosed and reboot. Includes text copied by XposedSmsCode while locked. Only the main Android user and default device clipboard are supported.
Keep syncing with the screen off
Keep the CPU and Wi-Fi active while LSPosed sync is enabled and a local network is available. Increases battery use; does not turn the screen on.
System hook connected. Enable Shared clipboard for each paired device. Sensitive content follows that device’s clipboard setting.

No recent response. Enable this module for the system server (system) scope in LSPosed, reboot, then reopen this screen. The android package alone does not target system_server in API 102. Unsupported ROM methods also cause this state.
Allow the battery exemption and your ROM’s autostart permission to keep syncing while locked. No root prompt is required.
